input.text:
image t(x, y)
    desc a0 = x walk=(32, 8)
    desc a1 = y walk=(32, 8)
    ainc a0 += 256
    vfill a0 -> l1[0] rel
    vfill a0 -> l1[8] rel
    vbar
    vunpk v2 <- l1[8] f16
    vpack v2 -> l1[16] f16
    vsync drain on=pack
    vdrain a1 <- l1[16]
    halt

fn t.l1(x: f16[256] @dram, y: f16[128] @dram)
    send vc[0]
        run t(x, y)
    barrier
